versions.content: {DRAFT} IEEE1722Tp destination MAC address definition In case the IEEE1722Tp message is sent, then the destination MAC address is deter- mined in one of two ways: • explicitly using the IEEE1722TpConnection . destinationMacAddress defi- nition, • or, if destinationMacAddress is not defined, implicitly using the IEEE1722TpConnection . macAddressStreamId definition.
